method: TDD: RED evidence captured from a live run BEFORE any source mutation; fix applied; GREEN captured after; full monorepo regression; dist build-artifact noise reverted so the committed diff is source-only.

D1_caption_place.symptom: caption.place -> payload validation failed: invalid_type, expected number, received string, path ["duration"]
D1_caption_place.rootCause: plan.ts paramSchema admitted numeric strings as scalars, so {start:"2",duration:"3.5"} parsed structurally; compiler.ts then forwarded op.params verbatim, so placeCaptionSchema (start/duration are z.number()) rejected the payload at the CommandBus seam.
D1_caption_place.fix: compiler.ts coerceNumericParam() converts a numeric string to a real Number for add_caption start/duration before emitting the payload. A present-but-non-numeric value (e.g. "three") throws AiSemanticError instead of being forwarded (fail-closed).

D2_changeAspect.symptom: project.changeAspect -> expected "'1920x1080' | '1080x1920' | '1080x1080'", received undefined, path ["ratio"]; producer-side invalid_union at ["operations",N,"params","place"]
D2_changeAspect.rootCause: Two seams. (a) plan.ts paramSchema was a scalar-only union (string|number|boolean), so a nested object param {place:{ratio:...}} was rejected at invalid_union before the compiler could ever resolve it. (b) The compiler forwarded op.params verbatim under whatever alias key the model chose (aspectRatio, place), so the canonical 'ratio' key the command schema requires was absent -> undefined.
D2_changeAspect.fix: plan.ts paramSchema widened to a recursive AiParamValue (string|number|boolean|array|record) so nested params are structurally admissible. compiler.ts resolveAspectRatio() resolves the canonical ratio from the known alias keys (ratio, aspectRatio, aspect_ratio, aspect, resolution, nested place.*) and emits a canonical payload {ratio: <canonical>} — alias keys are never forwarded. Unresolvable values throw AiSemanticError (fail-closed), never invented.

redEvidence.preconditions: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (503 packages) + pnpm rebuild esbuild were required first: the clone had no node_modules, so vitest could not run at all before the fix was even testable.
